fact: Law no. 2021-014 on electronic payment services and instruments was passed by the National Assembly and published in the Journal Officiel no. 1490 of 30 July 2021; it regulates payment service providers and e-money issuers operating in Mauritania (event date is the Official Gazette publication, as the excerpt gives no promulgation date).

fact: The Banque Centrale de Mauritanie issued Instruction no. 03/GR/2022 of 31 March 2022 regulating payment institutions, made under law no. 2021-014 of 5 July 2021 on electronic payment services and instruments.

fact: Instruction no. 03/GR/2022 (31 March 2022) defines payment institutions as legal entities licensed by the BCM other than credit institutions, and requires prior BCM licensing (minimum capital and guarantee deposit of 20 million MRU each) for anyone providing payment services in Mauritania.

fact: Loi n°2021-014 of 5 July 2021 on electronic payment services and means (113 articles, published in Journal Officiel n°1490) regulates payment service providers and e-money issuers in Mauritania and repeals Ordonnance n°2006-031 (art. 1, 112).

fact: Loi n°2021-014 (2021) bars anyone except banks from habitual payment-institution activity or e-money issuance and distribution without prior licensing by the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie, so non-bank payment institutions and e-money institutions can be licensed (art. 65, 80; defined art. 64, 75).
